html:
The Red Army invasion of Azerbaijan took place on 27 and 28 April 1920, when the Soviet 11th Army crossed the border and took Baku almost without a fight, ending the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.

The republic's army was tied down fighting Armenia in Karabakh, and local communists had prepared a takeover. Moscow wanted Baku's oil. The new Azerbaijan Soviet republic became part of the Transcaucasian federation and then, in 1936, a republic of the Soviet Union. Revolts in Ganja and elsewhere were crushed, and many leaders of the old republic were shot or fled to Turkey and Europe. The Soviets drew borders that left Nagorno Karabakh, with its Armenian majority, as an autonomous region inside Azerbaijan.
sum: The Red Army invasion of Azerbaijan took place on 27 and 28 April 1920, when the Soviet 11th Army crossed the border and took Baku almost without a fight, ending the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.
